title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC A-Level Geography Paper 1
description: A practice paper modelled on ZIMSEC A-Level Geography Paper 1 (physical geography): ten 25-mark structured questions, of which you answer any four, 100 marks, 3 hours. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **any four** questions. You have 3 hours.

- Each question is worth 25 marks. Use the resource in each question, named examples and, in the last part, a supported judgement.
- If you answer more than four questions, your best four count.

- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

Question sizes, part splits and the way choices are grouped are our convention; real papers vary. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC A-Level Geography Paper 3
description: A practice paper modelled on ZIMSEC A-Level Geography Paper 3 (practical geography): a compulsory statistics question, one mapping, GIS or remote sensing question and one research techniques question, 75 marks, 3 hours. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer the question in **Section A**, **one** question from Section B and **one** question from Section C. You have 3 hours. A calculator may be used.

- Each question is worth 25 marks. Show your working for every calculation.

- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.
